title: Is Gen Z Gambling Away Its Retirement? | Money Moves with Jill Schlesinger
summary: Gen Z is already skeptical they'll ever see a Social Security check. Now, a new survey suggests they're dipping into investment money to bet on sports. Jill, Mark and special guest Kayla Sabbagh unpack the headlines and explain what's really going on with Social Security. Plus, they help a 28-year-old Jillionaire figure out how to save for her first home.
